Built using deep time-series models and SeisBench for robust seismic monitoring and analysis.

rows.name: gridwatch-ai
rows.description: GridWatch AI is an explainable AI platform for electricity-demand forecasting, anomaly detection, load-pattern clustering, and grid-risk assessment. It combines LSTM, XGBoost, Isolation Forest, K-Means, SHAP, and RAG-based AI assistance with a FastAPI backend and React-TypeScript frontend.

Built with React, TypeScript, Python, and FastAPI to streamline inbox management and improve productivity.
